name: @warplan/tasks
description: Project task Lambda: ordered tasks, dependencies, and status transitions.

scripts.test:local: vitest run --config ../vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests --reporter=verbose tasks && terraform -chdir=terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform -chdir=terraform init -backend=false -input=false && terraform -chdir=terraform validate
scripts.test:agent: vitest run --config ../vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests --reporter=junit --outputFile=../test-results/tasks-agent.xml tasks && terraform -chdir=terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform -chdir=terraform init -backend=false -input=false && terraform -chdir=terraform validate
